theme: Necessity and efficiency cost of full nuisance-max protection
candidate_selection_data_notice: R0072 is DEV. Completed R0073 C1 has informed R2 direction and eligibility reasoning, so it is ALSO R2-development evidence, never R2 confirmation. Original frozen R1 C1 inference remains in its original scope.

R2P.mechanism: Remove the finite nuisance-max bank; retain original nuisance fit, learned nonnegative profiles, gamma, same pilot conversion and no own-Q weights. Exact ablation of the already archived plugin version, not a new inferential theorem.
R2P.prediction: Recover measured guard Power loss and reduce computation while retaining empirical validity over tested working regimes.
R2P.falsifier: Untreated composite-null FDR failure in targeted calibration stress, important utility regression, or failed exact plugin replay.

R2K.mechanism: Hold original target study shape, radial df and eta^2=(1-rho)*scatter fixed. Resample calibration vectors B=16; take rho_star=max(original and fitted bootstrap rhos), retaining original projection directions. Replace scatter by eta^2/(1-rho_star). For positive statistics all conditional scales grow with kappa(rho), so one rho_star replaces scanning the bank. Any calibration resample failure disables the affected K fold; original-fit failure is a visible experiment failure.
R2K.prediction: Retain protection for calibration-to-mean scale uncertainty without paying for unrelated target-shape/radial maximization.
R2K.falsifier: No usable Power gain over frozen R1, invalid FDR under matched stresses, or scalar-max equivalence failure.
R2K.assumptions: Same common-location, compound pipeline shape and independent calibration/genes as R1; frozen target fit is still estimated, not known. B16 maximum is NOT a confidence bound or general FDR certificate.

shared_rules: No new projection family, own-Q weighting, truth-based gate, actual-FDR threshold tuning or parameter grid.
All existing ordinary/support/weighted Bonferroni and empirical/BY-adjusted Simes baselines receive the SAME P or K frontend and original four pilot multiplier opportunities.
Same whole-family inputs and seed streams for all methods; no deletion of old adverse scenes.
Existing R1 and R0 results remain frozen; candidate outputs and failures are written to new run IDs.
For calibration resampling parity, consume the historical TRAIN-gene random indices before each calibration-row draw, without using those discarded indices to fit target nuisance.
Full original-parameter replay and all rho-max monotonicity/coherence tests before scientific comparison.

existing_development.reuse: Checksummed original input and original fitted nuisance/shape/profile/calibration resample receipts may be reused for paired mechanism decomposition. Cached run time is NOT deployment speed. Independently refit selected original inputs to verify replay parity.

targeted_fresh_development.scope_note: Matched structural model but smaller calibration/higher-rho than the prior C1 numerical range. Diagnostic extension, not existing R1 guarantee. Keep all results and do not relabel failures after seeing them.

decision_rule: Fixed development counts, no extra draws to chase significance. Evaluate full paired means, FDR and family Monte Carlo uncertainty, local losses and measured cost. At most one P/K version advances. Prefer simpler P if no unresolved reliability counterexample; choose K only if its protective mechanism has evidence and its cost is justified. If neither is adequate, retain scoped R1 and report the unclosed broader goal; no automatic third theme/search. Fresh C2 plan, errors and counts must be frozen only after selecting a defensible version; C2 remains exclusive .025 and can run only once.
